meta.merge_rule: STRICTLY ADDITIVE. Every amendment ADDS a new key to an incumbent play. No existing key on any incumbent is rewritten, reworded or deleted. Adjudication verifies all pre-existing keys byte-identical.

three_new_field_types.declined_evidence: The play was CONSULTED, correctly did NOT fire, and the state that made it decline. Closes the asymmetry where a fire earns forward_evidence and a correct decline leaves no trace - though S97 already treated a correct decline as evidence (C1: five fires, one correct decline, zero false positives).
three_new_field_types.negative_result_reported: A form TESTED AND LOST, recorded so it is not re-proposed. Precedent: flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard, whose recorded 0.5+k/sqrt(n) negative is why nobody re-proposed that form this run. Currently 1 of 62 plays.
three_new_field_types.assumption_retired: NEW FIELD TYPE, no precedent. What the play ASSUMED, the MEASUREMENT that replaced it, and what the play may now claim. This is the half with no existing home.

meta.run_limitation_recorded: Round 2 ran the five specialists in PARALLEL (handoffs precomputed from the actual, per doctrine). So A could not read E's or B's r2, and B could not read A's or E's r2. Several adjudications are therefore one-sided in the artifact even though they converge: B self-corrected in A's favour without seeing A's r2, and A, B and E independently reached the same verdict on the 0529 phase-3 reading. Convergence without communication is worth more than agreement after it, but the merge should not read the one-sided entries as unanswered.

value.assumed: That the seam ladder's rung-2 MAGNITUDE clause applies whenever the seam prior arms, independently of whether a distribution flip is also firing.

value.now_licensed: TERMINATION CLAUSE: when structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip fires, this ladder does not apply - the gap is demoted to one component of the standing extension rather than a separate prescription.
value.proposed_by: A (r2), after A withdrew its own rung-3 proposal. A calls it additive BY SUBTRACTION: no new play, no n=1 exemplar, removes authority from a falsified clause.

value.assumed: That the age arm (age >= 5) can be read off the chain-age LABEL.

value.g20_0601_pre_warning_fired_early: The play's own PRE-WARNING clause was satisfied on 0527 (+620 on sflow -4,910) and 0528 (+2,090 on -1,966) - two and three sessions before the seam. B and A both adopted this earlier trigger over A's seam-side arming.

B DECLINED it: 'that is fitting.' Recorded so the decline is not re-derived as an opportunity.

value.assumed: That price-down with flow-positive biases to the flow side (UP) unconditionally.
value.measured: G20 0604 close: structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell (b) reads the IDENTICAL state as failing (DOWN). Read literally this play flips 0605 to UP and loses 1,350. What actually selects is the distribution flip at cum +3,200 with the tell reversed.
value.now_licensed: Requires an explicit EXTENSION GATE. At block-extreme cum with the tell reversed, this play yields to the flip.

value.statement: Applied to the LAST PHASE rather than the whole session, the gate predicts the next day's terminal leg: an ABSORBED final phase delivers a POSITIVE terminal leg, an ALIGNED final phase delivers a NEGATIVE-to-flat one.
value.measured: 4 of 4 across D's two handoff pairs. Absorbed: 0528 ph3 -3,762 sflow under +160 px; 0603 ph3 -1,442 under +350. Aligned: 0527 ph3 -1,575 under -370; 0604 ph3 -2,816 under -90.
value.why_it_matters: D calls this the handoff's real payload on a print day - not the prior close's position in range.

value.tested_and_REJECTED_1: SIZE THE OVERNIGHT LEG BY close_off_low. Refuted on D's own pair: 0527 exits at 0.59 and its overnight ran -170; 0603 exits at 0.82 (more extended, so a give-back rule predicts DEEPER) and its overnight ran only -70. Wrong ordering.
value.tested_and_REJECTED_2: CONTINUE THE PRIOR FINAL-HOUR CONVICTION THROUGH THE SEAM. Refuted: 0603's last hour is dir +1 / flow +1 = aligned BUY delivery, predicting a positive overnight; realized -70.
value.conclusion: The handoff does NOT size the overnight leg. The overnight is ~4% of session volume (ph1 3,305 and 3,885 against 88,726 and 82,052 in ph2) and is not where the handoff pays. D declined to tune it.

value.g20_0528_self_caught: D's round 1 read ph3 correctly as 3,762 lots of sell absorbed under a rising price and then sized it as 'a token positive, not an extension' - the exact damp this play forbids ('never a cap ... size to the reversal move'). Round 2 caught its own violation and sized to the reversal at ~0.2x n0_net_sigma_5, cross-checked against the only two absorbed final phases available (+160, +350) and taken at the LOW end. This is the play working as a check on a specialist, not on the market.

value.g20_0528_correct_refusal: The incoming handoff's last_hour_dir -1 / last_hour_signed_flow -1 APPEARED to license a spent-downgrade of the 0528 pre-print band. Limb (a) refused it on its own text: it requires the exit SESSION to show positive conviction under falling price and states that a single final-phase give-back does NOT qualify. 0527's session and ph2 conviction are negative-under-rising. The gate CONFIRMED the band at its round-1 size and changed the number by zero.
value.why_recorded: D calls this the most valuable thing the handoff did on 0528. A correct decline currently leaves no trace in the brain; this is the asymmetry the declined_evidence field exists to close.

value.current_scope: The play already names the 06-10 window but scopes it to the WEEKEND SEAM.
value.measured: The 06:00-10:30 pre-print window is the largest leg on 8 of 10 G20 days, and on the two EIA Thursdays it is +1,060 of a +2,100 day and +1,030 of a +1,130 day (91%). The blind reproduced both negative overnight legs correctly and then truncated this leg to ~zero - 2,090 of D's 3,530 blind-vs-r1 gap.
value.mechanism: A crowded short that is still ADDING must de-risk before a scheduled binary, and that de-risk dates to the session's first liquid window, NOT to the print. There is no cold weather ramp here (gw_hdd 0.28-0.88), so catalyst_continuity_frontrun does not license it and nothing downstream can PRODUCE an up-band - the Thursday stack is all vetoes and no generator.
value.blind_available: YES - pre-decision flow plus a COT positioning extreme, both open-time.
value.also_corrects: D's own lens file: 'anchor to the print' applied literally puts the day's mass at 10:30; the right anchor is the print WINDOW, which opens ~06:00.

value.g20_both_thursdays: Run honestly on both days, only tell (b) fires on each - below the 2-of-3 bar - so the gate EXPLICITLY SPARED the full band on both, and the blind still emitted +150 and -450. Recorded because it establishes the gate was not the constraint: the failure was the absent generator, not an over-firing veto.

value.statement: A covering leg retraces IN FULL to its origin only when NO phase of it was validated by aligned flow. A leg containing a genuine aligned delivery phase is VALIDATED and gives back only its unvalidated residue.
value.measured: G20 0529 gave back 160 off a leg containing an aligned delivery phase (0528 ph2 sflow +1,684 / pxchg +2,020, ph_absorb FALSE). G20 0605 gave back 1,350 off a leg built entirely on absorbed selling (no aligned up phase anywhere in its table).
value.why_it_matters: It lets a Friday magnitude be derived as a LEVEL instead of guessed as a fraction. E used it to re-earn 0605 with no vol_regime term at all.
value.explicitly: An added ARM on this incumbent, NOT a new play. E said so unprompted.

value.g20_0527: C's r1 exit read of 0526 said the sell 'holds into the close'; the realized exit state says last_hour_dir +1, last_hour_signed_flow +1, low at 14:29 - the prior exited ALIGNED with the up-turn, so this gate removes the mid-week cap that WAS C's r1 0.80 multiplier. The un-cap is PARTIAL (0.80 -> 0.90, not 1.00) because the incoming close sits at close_off_low_frac 0.17: the bid appeared but the close is still in the bottom fifth of its range - the turn is signalled and not yet paid for. 520 -> 580 against a realized 610.
value.generalizes: The un-cap magnitude is scaled by the incoming close's location in its own range, not applied as a binary.

value.tested_and_REJECTED: C's own proposed remedy - recentring session_b_share BLOCK-RELATIVE - predicts next-session direction on only 2 of 8. C refuted its own r1 proposal in r2 and says explicitly: do NOT recentre gate (b).
value.what_to_do_instead: Replace it with the size-weighted big-print channel benchmarked against flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard's per-quartile equal-rate bars. Under the flat 0.55 bar C's 0603 trigger does not fire; under the q4 bar 0.547 it fires cleanly.

new_plays_proposed.one_line: When both aggressor sides fight to a draw at MAXIMUM volume and price still travels, the travel belongs to the resting book, not to either aggressor.
new_plays_proposed.trigger: (a) final-phase |net| below ~5% of the prior phase's, AND (b) final-phase volume AT OR ABOVE the session maximum.
new_plays_proposed.read: A fifth exit_type. Conviction is UNDEFINED BY CANCELLATION, not by absence - the distinction the round-1 name got wrong.
new_plays_proposed.measured: G20 0529: ph3 net -59 against ph2's -1,573, on 60,930 lots (session max, +18% over ph2), price travelling -810. The 0601 seam then gapped +690 - 85% of the -810 recovered before a single Monday session traded, with no publication, no catalyst and no flow. A completed transfer at maximum aggression does not do that; a passive-ladder failure does.
new_plays_proposed.history: Proposed in r1 as FLOWLESS_BID_WITHDRAWAL. B refuted the name and the participation reading; E conceded the fact and the mechanism-as-location, rejected the consequence, and the two ledgers reconcile: B has the aggressor ledger right, E has price formation right, and the CONJUNCTION is the finding.
new_plays_proposed.why_condition_b_is_mandatory: Without it the play is a false-positive machine - B's actual objection. Note it runs OPPOSITE to what 'flowless' implies.
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: A final phase meeting both conditions whose price travel is subsequently NOT recovered at the next seam.

new_plays_proposed.one_line: A thin session compresses NET and does not compress RANGE.
new_plays_proposed.read: When participation falls, price per unit of flow rises roughly as fast, so excursions survive even though the net does not. Scaling both by sqrt(participation) is wrong on the range half.
new_plays_proposed.measured: G20 0525 (Memorial Day, ~30% participation): realized day-move +30 against a derived holiday sigma of 360 = 0.08 sigma, so the NET scaling held exactly. Realized RANGE 1,140 against n0_range_20_mean 1,094 - compression 1.04x, not the predicted ~0.55x. A partial session printed a full-size regime range.
new_plays_proposed.mechanism_not_tail: A deadline-bound roll-in buyer facing a 13:00 early close in a thin book is a MECHANISM for overshoot-and-give-back, which is why A withdrew its r1 characterisation of the excursion as 'a reactive tail'.
new_plays_proposed.consequence: Affects the PATH, not the day-move. A's p50 peak +250 -> +550, day-move HELD at +60.
new_plays_proposed.proposed_by: A (r2), correcting its own r1 assumption

new_plays_proposed.one_line: A play keyed on cum_from_anchor or chain extension may assert a RUNG only for k <= 3 sessions from the block anchor; from k >= 4 it widens to the full band or stands down.
new_plays_proposed.why_deterministic_not_triggered: The blind CANNOT compute the divergence, and no never-masked proxy for realized cum survived testing. k is known in advance for a one-shot block blind, so this is a SCHEDULE, not a runtime signal.
new_plays_proposed.measured: Mean |constructed - realized| by k across G17-G20: 768 / 590 / 1,022 for k<=3; 2,182-2,730 for k>=4, against n0_range_20_mean ~1,094.
new_plays_proposed.applied_to_g20_0601: k=6, which stands down the seam play's cum-keyed rung-2 intraday arm and keeps its gap arm - the arm that was right at +690.
new_plays_proposed.forward_test: On G21+, record per day whether a cum-keyed play fired and at what k. PREDICTION: the blind's |err| on k>=4 days where a cum-keyed play fired exceeds its |err| on k>=4 days where none did. Zero or negative difference KILLS it.

new_plays_proposed.one_line: Under POSITIVE aggregate session signed flow, the size-weighted big-print channel says whether the absorber is still there - without price.
new_plays_proposed.trigger: Precondition: aggregate session signed flow POSITIVE and a guard-clean big-print sample (see flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard).
new_plays_proposed.read: Big prints STILL SELLING = absorber present = buy-absorption-failing risk live, take the turn small. Big prints FLIPPING BUY on a guard-clean sample = absorber gone = accumulation confirmed.
new_plays_proposed.measured: G20 0601->0602: sflow +3,796 positive, big_print_b_share 0.436 on 104 prints - big prints selling into a buying count tape; actual -80 against a blind +250. G20 0602->0603: sflow +3,524 positive, big prints FLIP to 0.585 on 122 prints, clearing the q4 equal-rate bar 0.547; actual +750.
new_plays_proposed.scope_HALF_ONLY: Covers sign(flow) = POSITIVE only. The mirror arm is REFUTED - under a negative count tape the big-print channel carries no next-session information (0527 .529 -> +2,100; 0528 .522 -> -160; 0604 .533 -> -1,340; 0603 .476 -> +1,130: two up, two down, and the one sell reading preceded the second-biggest up day).
new_plays_proposed.why_it_matters: It is BLIND-AVAILABLE and resolves the G18-0506 class with no price - the slot flow_conviction cannot fill because flow_conviction requires realized price and is refine-only. But it does NOT resolve the sell-tape-absorbed class (0527, 0604), which is where G20's largest errors actually sat.
new_plays_proposed.status: PROPOSED as a mechanism with a stated precondition, NOT an established play. n=2 firings plus one stand-down inside one block.

refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.claim: contract_structure / squeeze_watch assert a live NGM26 front on all ten G20 days with nothing in the state distinguishing the valid days from the dead ones; propose asserting days_to_calendar_front_expiry against the session date.
refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.verdict: REFUTED. The check already exists and is already firing. frozen_structure_stale is set on exactly the seven post-expiry days (0528 onward), carrying the frozen symbol, its expiry, the live front and an explicit not-decision-legit note, plus frozen_front_expired TRUE on both blocks - and it is DELIBERATELY ABSENT on 0525-0527 where the frozen vintage is factually current. That is S107 hole #5 and it implements A's crossover-date principle.
refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.consequence: C's BEHAVIOUR was right (it stood the block down on 0602/0603 in both rounds) but its use of the structure on 0527 was not 'accidentally correct' as it believed - the state was affirmatively telling it that day was legitimate. Merging the proposal would rebuild an existing feature and record a false lesson about a gap that does not exist.

refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.claim: A continuous chain integrates the blind's own directional error WITHOUT BOUND.

refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.claim: The divergence series is evidence for the chain-integration mechanism.
refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.raised_by: B (r1), and independently reproduced by the session lead from the scoreboard side

IMPORTANT: the session lead separately computed the same 4,050 / 1,490 split from the scoreboard and presented it to Greg as INDEPENDENT corroboration. It was not independent - it was the same quantity computed twice. Recorded so the divergence series is not recomputed next group and mistaken for a discovery.

refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.claim: chain_staleness_gate can be divergence-TRIGGERED on the blind side.
refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.verdict: REFUTED - no blind-side observable exists. Tested per-event on G18/G19/G20 against realized cum: cumulative session_signed_flow +0.614 / -0.815 / -0.591 (sign flips exactly into covering regimes); cot.managed_money_net +0.694 / -0.784 / -0.656 and only two values per block; cumulative volume_lots +0.556/+0.799/+0.832 - but corr(k, |real cum|) is +0.562/+0.785/+0.811, IDENTICAL, so it is the clock in disguise and its excess-over-run-rate sign-flips. The r1 threshold form is refine-only, i.e. useless where the problem is. Only the deterministic-in-k form survives.

refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.claim: A weekend bridge can detect the chain inversion without price.
refuted_DO_NOT_BANK.verdict: TWO OF THREE FAIL, and A reported one against its own instrument. COT FAILS: its report window (through 05-26) predates the 0527/0528 ramp, so over its own window a falling price with shorts adding is perfectly coherent. Per-day flow_conviction FAILS: the reading immediately before the seam is aligned-down and AGREES with the constructed chain. The cumulative impact integral works WEAKLY (0.110 over 0526-0529 against a 0.165 un-absorbed reference, a 33% deficit while flow magnitude rose 8x) - n=1 reference, proposal only. A states plainly: a bridge cannot recover a LEVEL it was never given.

the_surviving_blind_finding_for_gregs_de.headline: THE BLIND RUNS A REAL MEAN-REVERSION RULE ON A FICTITIOUS STATE VARIABLE - and that is NOT the same defect as the lean.
the_surviving_blind_finding_for_gregs_de.measured_1_the_market_premise: The market mean-reverts against REALIZED cum-from-anchor in every block measured: corr(act_t, real_cum_{t-1}) = -0.361 / -0.578 / -0.631 / -0.500 for G17/G18/G19/G20.
